reviews.text: We had a flawless experience working with Derek. We needed to refresh our backyard to make it better for our littles and growing family. We had Derek do a new fence and turf. Such an easy purchase. Amazing value for money. I looked at a few providers and none advised me like Derek when it came to what to do with my fence and how to decide on French drains. It was an easy purchase, his contractors were very polite, always on time, left our home better than it was when they arrived each day as they finished up work. Highly recommend Derek and Aqua Architects.
reviews.author: Justin McCollum

reviews.text: We recently had our pool lighting repaired by Aqua Architects, and the experience was excellent from start to finish. The team was professional, punctual, and knowledgeable about the work required. They quickly identified the issue and completed the repair efficiently, leaving everything working perfectly. Communication was clear throughout the process, and they made sure we were satisfied before wrapping up. Quality service all around! Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Lauren Young

reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with Aqua Architects. From start to finish, they were incredibly professional and truly made me feel like part of the family. Their attention to detail and dedication to quality work really stood out. It’s clear they take pride in what they do, and it shows in the final result. I would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for top-notch pool services — you won’t be disappointed! Great job Slade! Keep up the great work!
reviews.author: Carl M W

reviews.text: Slade is knowledgable and efficient. Pool completed timely and he continues to answer any questions I may have. Very pleased with his work.
reviews.author: Angie Lewis

reviews.text: Aqua Architects did a beautiful job on our pool! They were very reasonably priced, helpful with suggestions, and always on time. They cleaned up their construction mess, and provided just what we needed.
reviews.author: Heather Hess

reviews.text: Pool Architects fixed our skimmer leaks quickly and did a great job. The team was professional, efficient, and their pricing was very reasonable. Everything is working perfectly now. Highly recommend them if you need reliable pool repairs!
reviews.author: Kayla Odom

reviews.text: As a home inspector I have inspected many swimming pools. I have found that Aaqua Architects design and construction is over the top. I have no problem recommanding Aqua Architects for all of my clients, pool leads.
reviews.author: Jack Shouse

reviews.text:
The guys at Aqua Architects did a fantastic job updating our pool. We had an old painted finish which they quickly removed and prepared for the new plaster.  We chose the aqua blue plaster and we couldn't be happier with our choice.  They refreshed the entire pool in just days.
They were prompt, responsive, on time, quick and the final product is perfect. If you are like us and like a personal touch and responsive help, then we highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Brian Paul

data.summary: The reviews are overwhelmingly positive and appear authentic in content, mentioning specific staff and projects. However, the perfect 5.0 score across platforms with only 8 Google reviews and no critical feedback is unusual and raises mild suspicion. There is no evidence of fake review patterns like same-day posting, but the lack of any negative experiences is a red flag.
fake_signals: All reviews are 5-star with no critical feedback
Low total review volume (8) for a contractor
Review [7] is from a home inspector, which could be a strategic placement
Some reviews are generic and lack specific project details

positive_evidence: Reviewer mentions contractor continues to answer questions post-completion

authentic_signals: Reviews describe specific services (fence, turf, pool lighting repair, plaster refresh)
Mention of reasonable pricing and cleanup
data.discrepancy_explanation: All available ratings (Google and Yelp) are perfect 5.0 scores. No contradictory low ratings or BBB complaints were found to create a discrepancy.
